questions_and_answers.question_text: हम लोग अगले साल भारत जाना चाहते हैं ।

answers.answer_text: We want to go to India next year.

answers.answer_text: I want to see all the famous places there.

answers.answer_text: We don't want to stay in India for more than a year.

answers.answer_text: Does she know how to drive a car?
